text:
Priya: Pushing a polish pass for the batch vectors preview and column-mapping flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main goals: (1) make CSV mapping clearer for non-technical users, (2) small keyboard/a11y fixes on the preview table, (3) add an export preset dropdown for common schemas. Quick skim please.

Jamal: Love the export preset idea. Suggest presets: 'Minimal (id + vector)', 'Full (text + metadata + vector)', and 'Rerank-friendly (text + relevance_score + vector)'. Presets should show a short description under the dropdown.

Evelyn: Copy nits: change 'Map columns' header to 'Match your CSV columns' and in the tooltip say 'Tip: columns can be renamed later in the export.' Also the CSV sample header in the preview should show human-friendly labels (Original text -> "Text (for context)").

Riley: A11y/keyboard: table rows should be reachable as role="row" with each cell role="gridcell". When a row is focused, pressing Enter opens the detail drawer; focus must move to the drawer's first interactive element. Add visible focus styles for keyboard users on the preset dropdown and mapping chips.

Priya: For the preset UX: clicking a preset pre-selects a set of columns and toggles export options (include_vector_dims, precision=3). Users can still edit selections. We should persist last-chosen preset per workspace.

Jamal: Backend constraints: we can pre-generate the 'Minimal' export quickly, but 'Full' may need async processing for >2k rows. Recommend showing estimated size and a checkbox 'Notify me when ready'. Also include a sample row count estimate before export.

Evelyn: On the preview table, show a small 'sampled' badge when only the first N rows are loaded (e.g., 'Sampled: 100 rows'). Also change the small 'score' column label to 'Relevance (score)' and cap to 3 decimals.

Riley: For screen readers: the preset dropdown should have aria-haspopup and aria-expanded attributes. In the detail drawer, announce 'Details for vector_id: 12345' via aria-live when opened.

Priya: Example preset descriptions for the dropdown (short):
- Minimal: "id + compressed vector (fast export)"
- Full: "text, metadata, vector dims (includes source filenames)"
- Rerank-ready: "text, relevance score, vector (best for reranking)"

Evelyn: Export CSV header suggestion for Full preset: 
```
vector_id,text_for_context,relevance_score,vector_dims,source_filename,created_at
```
Make sure column names use snake_case for downstream scripts.

Jamal: Confirming we'll include source_filename if available. Also add an optional column 'original_id' for users who track upstream ids. For large exports: pagination + server-side sort will be required.

Riley: Keyboard flow: Tab sequence in the mapping modal should be: preset dropdown -> mapping table -> preview sample size selector -> Export button. Pressing Esc anywhere closes modal and returns focus to the trigger.

Priya: UX microcopy tweak for empty mapping state: replace 'No columns mapped' with 'No columns matched. Drag headers or pick a column to map.' Add a small link 'See mapping examples' that opens a microhelp tooltip.

Evelyn: Small accessibility reminder: color alone shouldn't be used to indicate the selected preset. Use an icon or outline as well.

Jamal: I'll add server-side limits and async job for >2000 rows. ETA: next Wednesday for the first version.

Riley: I'll draft the aria attributes and keyboard specs and post a short checklist.

Priya: I'll update Figma with the preset dropdown, descriptions, and the new copy changes. Will also add the sampled badge.

ux-bot: Added comments on the Figma frames (mapping modal, preset dropdown) and created ticket #UI-4782 for export presets.

Priya: Thanks everyone ":raised_hands:". Action list: Priya (Figma updates), Jamal (backend limits + async), Riley (a11y checklist), Evelyn (copy examples). Target: design review next Thursday.
